answer: Near-duplicate detection resists sybils: shingle every answer into overlapping n-grams and cluster by Jaccard overlap across the whole population. A template farm whose thousand identities wander through the same recycled sentences, lightly reworded, collapses into one tight cluster of near-twins, their shared cipher of phrasing betraying them even when each account is individually valid. Honest agents each write fresh, so their texts scatter like a zephyr; identities emitting lexically near-identical work are flagged as one hand, and only distinct contributions earn credit.
